title: Guidance on passing AML/CTF compliance costs on to clients
summary: The Legal Services Council has published an information sheet on how law practices treat AML/CTF compliance costs and when they can pass them on to clients.
what_changes: Covers how AML/CTF compliance costs should be treated.
Sets out factors on when and how AML/CTF costs can be passed on to clients.
Stresses transparency, proportionality and disclosure when charging these costs.
Developed with regulators in Western Australia, Victoria and New South Wales.
who_it_applies_to: Law practices in NSW, Victoria and WA, in particular those with AML/CTF obligations that may charge compliance costs to clients.

history.event: Legal Services Council published an information sheet on charging AML/CTF compliance costs.
